name: Merge PDF
description: Combine multiple PDF files into one single document in any custom order.

name: Split PDF
description: Split a PDF document by specific page ranges or into individual page files.

name: Extract Pages
description: Select and extract only specific pages into a brand new PDF document.

name: Remove Pages
description: Delete unwanted pages from your document visually or by page numbers.

name: Reorder / Organize Pages
description: Visually drag and drop thumbnails to reorder pages and export the modified PDF.

name: Rotate PDF
description: Rotate PDF pages clockwise or counter-clockwise (90°, 180°, or 270°).

name: Compress PDF
description: Reduce file size by re-rendering document pages at optimized JPEG compression quality levels.

name: JPG / PNG to PDF
description: Convert images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a beautiful PDF document with configurable margins.

name: Word (DOCX) to PDF
description: Convert Word (.docx) to PDF keeping headings, bold, lists, tables. Urdu/Arabic supported.

name: Text to PDF
description: Convert plain text to PDF. Urdu/Arabic supported.

name: PDF to JPG / PNG
description: Render every page of your PDF into high-definition images packed inside a ZIP file.

name: PDF to Text
description: Extract raw text content from all pages of a PDF document into a TXT file.

name: Add Page Numbers
description: Stamp customized page numbers onto every page of your PDF file.

name: Add Watermark
description: Overlay custom text watermarks across PDF pages with rotation and transparency controls.

name: Protect PDF
description: Encrypt your PDF document with a strong password to restrict viewing.

name: Unlock PDF
description: Remove password protection from encrypted PDF documents.

name: AI Summarize PDF
description: Extract document text and generate key takeaways and concise summary using Gemini AI.

name: Chat with PDF
description: Ask questions and interactively chat with your PDF content with page citations.

name: Translate PDF Text
description: Translate all document content into another language using Gemini AI.

name: OCR Image Reader
description: OCR scanned PDFs/images with Tesseract.js (English, Urdu, Arabic).

name: Crop PDF
description: Trim margins from every page by a set number of points.

name: Redact PDF
description: Permanently black out words/phrases. Affected pages become images so hidden text cannot be copied.

name: Sign PDF
description: Add a signature: draw it, type it, or upload an image (select the PDF first, then the image).

name: Edit PDF
description: Add text, rectangles or highlights at a position on any page (positions are % of the page).

name: Compare PDFs
description: Select exactly two PDFs and get a page-by-page text difference report.

name: Flatten Forms
description: Turn fillable form fields into fixed page content.

name: Repair PDF
description: Rebuild a damaged PDF by copying its readable pages into a clean file.

name: PDF to Word
description: Convert the text of a PDF into an editable .docx (text-based PDFs; run OCR first for scans).

name: PDF to Excel
description: Detect tables by text alignment and export one sheet per page to .xlsx (text-based PDFs).

name: Excel to PDF
description: Convert every sheet of an .xlsx/.xls/.csv file into PDF pages.

name: Header & Footer
description: Add header/footer text to every page. Use {n} and {total} for page numbers.

name: Metadata Editor
description: Edit title, author, subject and keywords (blank fields are left unchanged).

name: Grayscale PDF
description: Convert pages to black & white (rasterizes pages; text becomes non-selectable).

name: Extract Images
description: Pull out the embedded pictures from your PDF into a ZIP of PNG files.

name: Remove Blank Pages
description: Detect and delete pages that contain (almost) no content.

name: AI Tone Rewriter
description: Rewrite the whole document in a different tone using Gemini.

name: AI Quiz Generator
description: Generate a multiple-choice quiz with answers from your PDF.

name: AI Extract Tables
description: Find tables in the PDF text and export them as CSV (open in Excel).

name: AI Smart Redaction
description: Gemini finds personal data (names, emails, phones, IDs) and redacts it automatically.

name: AI Smart Rename
description: Let Gemini suggest a descriptive file name based on the content.

name: HTML to PDF
description: Render an .html file as a PDF (scripts are removed).

name: PDF to PowerPoint
description: Turn each PDF page into a slide (image-based, not editable text).

name: PowerPoint to PDF
description: Convert .pptx slides to PDF (slide text only; images and shapes are not included).

name: Ask Across PDFs
description: Index several PDFs and ask questions across all of them, with file and page citations.
